Using Quality Engineering principles — Six Sigma, Lean, Advanced Problem Solving, and Root Cause Analysis — you will help ensure processes and products meet company specifications, including QSR and ISO requirements. You will also support process and product improvement projects and coordinate quality initiatives across business units.
cond_0054.responsibilities:
Coordinate with teams throughout the life cycle of [Product name masked] products — including process design and development, manufacturing, and purchasing — to support and advance quality improvement projects.
Work alongside engineering and operations teams using Quality Engineering and Six Sigma tools to establish sampling plans, develop quality plans, and support reliability engineering activities.
Participate in FMEA activities and help facilitate risk assessments; support change management systems in coordination with relevant stakeholders.
Conduct and participate in process and systems audits, and assist in specification development.
Analyze routine and test data together with the team to identify improvement opportunities.
Participate in design of experiments (DOEs) for process and product improvement and validation testing.
Coordinate statistical analysis for sampling plan rationale, including DOEs, Paretos, ANOVA, and SPC applications.
Work with manufacturing teams to evaluate quality performance capability and help develop criteria to monitor and improve existing processes.
Investigate nonconforming material alongside relevant teams to help determine root cause and support corrective and preventive action.
Help lead teams responsible for improvement activities.
Develop and execute validation plans in coordination with cross-functional partners.
Work with the business unit to develop personal and departmental performance objectives and share monthly progress updates against those goals.
Apply knowledge of the Quality System Regulation (21 CFR Part 820, including 21 CFR 806) and ISO 13485 requirements.
Partner with the Global QE team to deliver executive and/or client workshops and training as required.
Support process mapping and modeling, and share guidance and options with relevant stakeholders.
cond_0054.requirements:
Extensive knowledge of business process management, scorecards and dashboards, improvement methodologies, project management, matrix program leadership, and ROI measurement.
Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or government regulations. Able to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals. Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of senior managers and the general public.
Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference, and fundamentals of plane and solid geometry and trigonometry. Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.
Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists. Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram format.
Experience establishing OEE and SPC requirements as needed.
Minimum of 5 years applicable experience and/or training, or equivalent combination of education and experience with medical device manufacturing.
Bachelor's degree (B.A.) from a four-year college or university. Certified Quality Engineer, Six Sigma certified Black Belt or Green Belt, and Lean/manufacturing knowledge.

This role works alongside cross-functional teams to support quality engineering principles — including Six Sigma, Lean, advanced problem solving, and root cause analysis — to help develop and optimize systems and processes aligned with overall company strategy. The role also supports process and product validations to ensure compliance with company specifications, QSR, and ISO requirements, and collaborates on process and product improvement projects.
cond_0081.responsibilities:
Coordinate with teams across the product lifecycle — including process design and development, manufacturing, and purchasing — to support and advance quality improvement projects for [Company name masked] products.
Work with quality engineering and Six Sigma tools and techniques to help establish sampling plans, develop quality plans, and participate in FMEA activities.
Support reliability engineering activities, assist in specification development, and take part in change management systems.
Facilitate risk assessments using FMEA in coordination with relevant stakeholders.
Analyze routine and test data together with the team to identify improvement opportunities.
Participate in design of experiments (DOEs) for process and product improvement and validation testing.
Coordinate statistical analysis for sampling plan rationale and analysis, including DOEs, Paretos, ANOVA, and SPC applications.
Work with manufacturing teams to evaluate quality performance capability and help develop criteria to monitor and improve existing processes.
Investigate instances of nonconforming material and work with teams to determine root cause and corrective/preventive action.
Coordinate teams responsible for improvement activities and help execute validation plans.
Collaborate within the business unit to develop personal and departmental performance objectives, and share monthly progress reports against those goals.
Apply knowledge of the Quality System Regulation (21 CFR Part 820, including 21 CFR 806) and ISO 13485 requirements.
Partner with the Global QE team to support executive and/or client workshops and training as needed.
Contribute to process mapping and modeling, and share guidance and options with relevant teams.
cond_0081.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Minimum of 5 years of applicable experience and/or training, or equivalent combination of education and experience in medical device manufacturing.
Bachelor's degree (B.A.) from a four-year college or university.
Proficiency in Quality System Regulation (21 CFR Part 820, including 21 CFR 806) and ISO 13485 requirements.
Ability to read, analyze, and interpret business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or government regulations.
Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals.
Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as probability, statistical inference, geometry, and trigonometry, and to apply fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.
Ability to solve practical problems and interpret instructions in written, oral, or diagram format.
Preferred Requirements
Certified Quality Engineer, Six Sigma Black Belt or Green Belt certification, and Lean/manufacturing knowledge.
Extensive knowledge of business process management, scorecards and dashboards, improvement methodologies, project management, matrix program leadership, and ROI measurement.
Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from senior managers and the general public.
Experience establishing OEE and SPC requirements.

cond_0288.intro: We are looking for a Quality Engineer to join our team. This role works alongside cross-functional teams to develop and optimize systems and processes aligned with overall company strategy. Using Quality Engineering principles — Six Sigma, Lean, Advanced Problem Solving, and Root Cause Analysis — you will help ensure processes and products meet company specifications, including QSR and ISO requirements. You will also support process and product improvement projects and coordinate quality initiatives across business units.
cond_0288.responsibilities:
Coordinate with teams throughout the life cycle of [Product name masked] products — including process design and development, manufacturing, and purchasing — to support and advance quality improvement projects.
Work alongside engineering and operations teams using Quality Engineering and Six Sigma tools to establish sampling plans, develop quality plans, and support reliability engineering activities.
Participate in FMEA activities and help facilitate risk assessments; support change management systems in coordination with relevant stakeholders.
Conduct and participate in process and systems audits, and assist in specification development.
Analyze routine and test data together with the team to identify improvement opportunities.
Participate in design of experiments (DOEs) for process and product improvement and validation testing.
Coordinate statistical analysis for sampling plan rationale, including DOEs, Paretos, ANOVA, and SPC applications.
Work with manufacturing teams to evaluate quality performance capability and help develop criteria to monitor and improve existing processes.
Investigate nonconforming material alongside relevant teams to help determine root cause and support corrective and preventive action.
Help lead teams responsible for improvement activities.
Develop and execute validation plans in coordination with cross-functional partners.
Work with the business unit to develop personal and departmental performance objectives and share monthly progress updates against those goals.
Apply knowledge of the Quality System Regulation (21 CFR Part 820, including 21 CFR 806) and ISO 13485 requirements.
Partner with the Global QE team to deliver executive and/or client workshops and training as required.
Support process mapping and modeling, and share guidance and options with relevant stakeholders.
cond_0288.requirements:
Extensive knowledge of business process management, scorecards and dashboards, improvement methodologies, project management, matrix program leadership, and ROI measurement.
Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or government regulations. Able to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals. Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of senior managers and the general public.
Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference, and fundamentals of plane and solid geometry and trigonometry. Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.
Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists. Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram format.
Experience establishing OEE and SPC requirements as needed.
Minimum of 5 years applicable experience and/or training, or equivalent combination of education and experience with medical device manufacturing.
Bachelor's degree (B.A.) from a four-year college or university. Certified Quality Engineer, Six Sigma certified Black Belt or Green Belt, and Lean/manufacturing knowledge.

cond_0365.responsibilities:

cond_0558.intro: We are looking for a Quality Engineer to join our team. This role works alongside cross-functional teams to develop and optimize systems and processes aligned with overall company strategy. Using Quality Engineering principles — Six Sigma, Lean, Advanced Problem Solving, and Root Cause Analysis — you will help ensure processes and products meet company specifications, including QSR and ISO requirements. You will also support process and product improvement projects and coordinate quality initiatives across business units.
cond_0558.responsibilities:
Coordinate with teams throughout the life cycle of [Product name masked] products — including process design and development, manufacturing, and purchasing — to support and advance quality improvement projects.
Work alongside engineering and operations teams using Quality Engineering and Six Sigma tools to establish sampling plans, develop quality plans, and support reliability engineering activities.
Participate in FMEA activities and help facilitate risk assessments; support change management systems in coordination with relevant stakeholders.
Conduct and participate in process and systems audits, and assist in specification development.
Analyze routine and test data together with the team to identify improvement opportunities.
Participate in design of experiments (DOEs) for process and product improvement and validation testing.
Coordinate statistical analysis for sampling plan rationale, including DOEs, Paretos, ANOVA, and SPC applications.
Work with manufacturing teams to evaluate quality performance capability and help develop criteria to monitor and improve existing processes.
Investigate nonconforming material alongside relevant teams to help determine root cause and support corrective and preventive action.
Help lead teams responsible for improvement activities.
Develop and execute validation plans in coordination with cross-functional partners.
Work with the business unit to develop personal and departmental performance objectives and share monthly progress updates against those goals.
Apply knowledge of the Quality System Regulation (21 CFR Part 820, including 21 CFR 806) and ISO 13485 requirements.
Partner with the Global QE team to deliver executive and/or client workshops and training as required.
Support process mapping and modeling, and share guidance and options with relevant stakeholders.
cond_0558.requirements:
Extensive knowledge of business process management, scorecards and dashboards, improvement methodologies, project management, matrix program leadership, and ROI measurement.
Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or government regulations. Able to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals. Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of senior managers and the general public.
Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference, and fundamentals of plane and solid geometry and trigonometry. Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.
Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists. Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram format.
Experience establishing OEE and SPC requirements as needed.
Minimum of 5 years applicable experience and/or training, or equivalent combination of education and experience with medical device manufacturing.
Bachelor's degree (B.A.) from a four-year college or university. Certified Quality Engineer, Six Sigma certified Black Belt or Green Belt, and Lean/manufacturing knowledge.

It oversees process and product validations to assure all processes comply with company specifications, including QSR and ISO requirements. The role reviews, develops, and maintains all associated documentation, assists in process and product improvement projects, provides technical input and assistance, and leads quality initiatives in business units. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with quality engineering and process improvement work.
cond_0617.responsibilities:
Leads, supports, consults, and trains quality improvement projects throughout the life cycle of [Product name masked] products, including process design and development, manufacturing, and purchasing.
Utilizes quality Engineering / Six Sigma tools and techniques to establish sampling plans, develops quality plans, conducts and participates in FMEA activities, support reliability engineering activities, conduct process and systems audits and to assist in specification development.
Facilitate risk assessment using FMEA and take part in change management systems.
Analyzes routine and test data for improvement opportunities.
Participates in the designs experiments (DOE's) for process and product improvement and validation testing.
Leads statistical analysis for sampling plan rationale and analysis, including but not limited to, DOEs, Paretos, ANOVA, and SPC applications.
Evaluates manufacturing quality performance capability and develop criteria to monitor and improve existing processes.
Investigates instances of nonconforming material and facilitates the determination of root cause and corrective action/preventive action.
Lead teams responsible for the improvement activities.
Develop/execute validation plans.
Participate in business unit to develop personal and departmental performance objectives.
Reporting monthly on progress made against those goals.
Proficient in knowledge of the quality System Regulation (21 CFR PART 820, including 21CFR806) and ISO 13485 requirements.
Partners with Global QE team to deliver executive and/or client workshops and training as required.
Provides process mapping and modeling, and provides guidance/options.
cond_0617.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Minimum of 5 plus years applicable experience and/or training or equivalent combination of education and experience with medical device manufacturing.
Bachelor's degree (B.A.) from four-year college or university.
Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or government regulations. Able to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals. Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of senior managers and the general public.
Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference, and fundamentals of plane and solid geometry and trigonometry. Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios and proportions to practical situations.
Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists. Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral or diagram format.
Establishes OEE and SPC requirements as needed.
Preferred Requirements
Certified Quality Engineer, Six Sigma certified Black Belt – Green Belt, Lean/manufacturing knowledge.
Extensive knowledge of business process management, scorecards and dashboards, improvement methodologies, project management, matrix program leadership and ROI (return on investment) measurement.
cond_0617.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
